description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the SQL Server LocalDB database connection to Azure SQL Database with Managed Identity authentication
tasks.reason: The application uses SQL Server LocalDB with a credential-based connection string. Migrating to Azure SQL Database with Managed Identity removes hardcoded credentials and enables secure, passwordless access in the cloud.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the SQL Server LocalDB connection in SchoolContextFactory and Web.config to use Azure SQL Database. Replace connection string credentials with Managed Identity (passwordless) authentication. Ensure Entity Framework Core 3.1 with the SqlServer provider continues to function correctly against Azure SQL Database.

tasks.description: Migrate the MSMQ-based NotificationService to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity authentication
tasks.reason: The application uses MSMQ (System.Messaging) for notification queuing. MSMQ is a Windows-only, on-premises technology that does not work in cloud or container environments. Azure Service Bus provides equivalent functionality with cloud-native reliability and Managed Identity support.
tasks.requirements: Replace System.Messaging.MessageQueue usage in NotificationService with Azure Service Bus. Migrate queue creation, message send, and message receive operations to Azure Service Bus equivalents. Use Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) for authentication. Update Web.config configuration to reference the Azure Service Bus namespace endpoint instead of an MSMQ path. Preserve existing SendNotification and ReceiveNotification method signatures.

tasks.description: Migrate teaching material file uploads from the local file system to Azure Blob Storage with Managed Identity authentication
tasks.reason: The application saves uploaded teaching material images to a local file system path (~/Uploads/TeachingMaterials/). Local file system storage is not suitable for cloud deployments due to lack of persistence, scalability, and accessibility across multiple instances. Azure Blob Storage provides durable, scalable storage with Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace local file system operations in CoursesController (upload, delete) with Azure Blob Storage SDK calls. Migrate file save (SaveAs) and file delete (File.Delete) operations to blob upload and blob delete operations respectively. Use Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) for authentication to Azure Blob Storage. Update the TeachingMaterialImagePath stored on the Course model to reference the Azure Blob URL instead of a local file path. Maintain existing validation logic for file type and file size.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate CVEs in project dependencies
tasks.reason: Before deploying to Azure, all known vulnerabilities in project dependencies must be identified and resolved to ensure the application meets security compliance requirements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, current version, upgraded major version, and breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime environment: .NET Framework 4.8. Build tool: MSBuild with packages.config.
